items.title: Irrationality becomes one cofinal divisibility question
items.why: The original series problem is reduced without loss to an integer event that can be attacked directly.
items.hard_step: Force failures of m dividing the strict successor beyond every cutoff.
items.attribution: Classical factorial radix context; source specific formal synthesis; no priority claim.
items.boundary: No cofinal producer is known, so Erdős #68 remains open.

items.title: One universal Mersenne residue gap is the exact frontier
items.why: Several competing attack languages collapse to one forced basepoint modular supply with the full quantifier order visible.
items.hard_step: Produce the strict centered gap for every basepoint and every positive odd denominator shape.
items.attribution: Classical radix tails, Euler periodicity and modular arithmetic; no priority claim for the packaging.
items.boundary: The universal gap supply is unproved, so Erdős #249 remains open.
items.paper_caveat: The paper covers the problem; this particular equivalence is in the Lean source, not in it.

items.title: The prime series is exactly a weighted gap tail
items.why: Summation by parts keeps the endpoint and identifies the actual infinite obstruction, instead of treating prime irregularity as evidence by itself.
items.evidence: Lean checked identity, convergence and rational affine equivalence
items.hard_step: Prove an infinite obstruction for the genuine consecutive prime gap tail.
items.attribution: Exact summation by parts with a direct public antecedent; no new prime gap theorem or novelty claim.
items.boundary: Finite denominator screens and generic gap countermodels do not prove irrationality, so Erdős #251 remains open.
items.question_html: Is ∑ p<sub>n</sub>/2<sup>n</sup> over the consecutive primes irrational?

items.title: Rational membership means actual skips forever
items.why: A set existence question becomes a statement about one canonical greedy orbit, with no freedom to choose a convenient support.
items.evidence: Lean checked exact equivalence for every nonnegative rational target
items.hard_step: Produce cofinal actual skips for 1/2, 1/21 or another unresolved target.
items.attribution: Uses the classical Erdős Borwein irrationality theorem inside a source specific greedy synthesis; no priority claim.
items.boundary: Finite traces and arbitrary omitted supports do not supply the canonical cofinal skips, so Erdős #257 remains open.
items.question_html: Is ∑<sub>a ∈ A</sub> 1/(2<sup>a</sup> − 1) irrational for every infinite set A of positive integers?

items.title: A constant factor path exists in every degree
items.why: The unrestricted geometry has an absolute all degree bound, while the critical level singularity becomes the precise obstruction to the sharp target.
items.evidence: Authored ordinary universal proof with finite regression; no Lean or independent specialist review
items.hard_step: Review the component coarea calculation and remove the enlargement from K_mu to K_(2mu).
items.attribution: Classical length area, coarea and lemniscate mechanisms; the exact synthesis was not located in bounded search and no priority is claimed.
items.boundary: The constant is 8, the path lies in K_(2mu), and Erdős #1041 remains open.
items.question_html: For a monic polynomial with every root inside the unit disc, can two roots always be joined by a curve shorter than 2 that stays inside the lemniscate |f| < 1?
items.paper_caveat: No Lean statement: this one is an ordinary written proof.
